attributes.name: torso_bent_forward
attributes.text: The torso bends forward from the hips.
attributes.definition: The upper spine moves clearly in front of the hips, more than a slight lean, at some point in the action.

attributes.name: head_bowed_down
attributes.text: The head tilts down toward the hands and stays down.
attributes.definition: The head stays pitched downward for most of the action, usually toward hands held in front.

attributes.name: head_tilted_back
attributes.definition: The head pitches back so the face points upward relative to the torso for a moment.

attributes.name: seated
attributes.text: The person is sitting with hips at seat height.
attributes.definition: The hips are low and the thighs roughly horizontal with the feet on the floor for much of the action.

attributes.name: deep_knee_bend
attributes.text: Both knees bend deeply and the hips drop low.
attributes.definition: Both knees flex strongly so the hips come down well below standing height.

attributes.name: stand_on_one_leg
attributes.text: The body is supported on one leg while the other foot is off the floor.
attributes.definition: One foot leaves the floor and is held up while the other leg alone supports the body.

attributes.name: elbow_raised_to_side
attributes.text: The elbow is lifted out to the side at about shoulder height.
attributes.definition: The elbow joint moves out sideways from the torso and up near shoulder level.

attributes.name: shoulders_rounded_forward
attributes.text: The shoulders hunch forward and inward.
attributes.definition: Both shoulders move forward and slightly together, giving a curled upper back.

attributes.name: torso_twisted
attributes.text: The torso twists so the shoulders turn relative to the hips.
attributes.definition: The line between the shoulders rotates away from the line between the hips.

attributes.name: torso_tilted_sideways
attributes.text: The torso leans to one side.
attributes.definition: The spine tilts toward the left or right so one shoulder is clearly lower than the other.

attributes.name: hands_held_overhead
attributes.text: The hands are held at or above head height.
attributes.definition: Both or one hand stays at or above the top of the head for a held moment.

attributes.name: arm_straight_extended
attributes.text: An arm is held straight with the elbow extended.
attributes.definition: The elbow is near fully straight and the arm is held out from the body.

attributes.name: hand_tip_above_wrist
attributes.text: The raised hand is held upright with the fingertips above the wrist.
attributes.definition: While the hand is held raised, the hand-tip and thumb joints are above the wrist joint.

attributes.name: hand_tip_below_wrist
attributes.text: The hand points down with the fingertips or thumb below the wrist.
attributes.definition: While the hand is active, the hand-tip or thumb joint is clearly below the wrist joint.
